articles.title: Power struggle erupts at Ondo Finance after founder’s death
articles.snippet: Three Delaware court filings reveal a battle for control of Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death.

articles.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid ETF inflows have stalled as competition mounts
articles.snippet: After leading crypto ETF inflows in May and June, demand for Hyperliquid funds stalled in July and August as competition intensified, the bank said.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s low volatility doesn’t necessarily mean low risk
Free Markets and Innovation, Sort Of
articles.snippet: The Journal’s editorial board rejects crypto competition and instead misinterprets Clarity, a pro-innovation, pro-competition, and pro-consumer bill, argues the Blockchain Association's Summer Mersinger.

articles.title: Why Sandisk and Western Digital crashed 10% and what it means for bitcoin
articles.snippet: Strong earnings from SanDisk and Western Digital were not enough to satisfy investors, raising questions about whether capital is beginning to rotate from AI winners into crypto.
